_comment: Editorial content for INKL. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: the factory photography on the company site is not licence-cleared.
description: International Knitwear Limited was incorporated in May 1990 and runs a vertically integrated knitwear operation in Karachi, with in-house processing and knitting facilities. It exports knitwear to store chains and international brands in Europe, the Middle East and the United States.
sourceNote: Company website (internationalknitwear.com: home, about/profile-of-company, governance), read 2026-10-17.
